extraction.Name: George Harvey (allottee, deceased); affidavit given by Susie Keester, nee Harvey (daughter)
extraction.Refused/Protested: he did not want this patent in fee, as he did not want to pay taxes; but he was informed that, if he did not accept the patent, and pay the taxes, it would be taxed just the same, and later sold for same, so he took the patent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1920, he mortgaged 200 acres of this allotment to the Security & Savings Bank of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $800.00, they keeping $60.00 of this as commission for making the loan
extraction.Buyer: Security & Savings Bank of Rapid City, South Dakota; mortgage of 200 acres for $800.00 ($60.00 kept as commission); at time of Mr. Harvey's death they still had hold of his land and were preparing to acquire the whole section
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: her father never paid any taxes on this land; the reason for borrowing this money was to pay grazing lease and to buy seed; in 1925, her father went to the bank and asked them to accept the 200 acres for the mortgage and that he would sell another 160 acres of land to get money to pay taxes on the balance, but the banker refused
extraction.Gender: Female (deponent Susie Keester); Male (allottee George Harvey)
extraction.NOTES: Affidavit No. 2718; allottee George Harvey died July 11, 1928; allotment of 638.46 acres described as all the fractional section 10, T.41N., R.43W. and the NW1/4 of SW, Sec. 11, T.41N., R.43W., of the 6th P.M., in South Dakota; $80.00 interest has been paid on the mortgage; father did not make any will; his business was in bad shape, having been sick for years prior to death; father received a letter before his death ordering him to move off the land, which he refused to do; deponent has a brother who lives with his mother, farms his own land, and supports his mother; George Harvey never received any aid from the County, State, nor the United States Government; never sold land for debts incurred prior to receiving fee patent; affidavit sworn April 23, 1929 | Allotment number 2718 from source page 88 (No. 2718 visible on same page as affidavit). Prior auto-recovery incorrectly assigned 2707 from adjacent page 87. | TASK 3 BULK TRIBE INFERENCE 2026-04-29: Tribe field set to 'Pine Ridge' based on directory provenance (record is filed in pine_ridge_*/extractions/, which corresponds to the NARA RG 75 Pine Ridge Vol 1, Vol 2, and Vol 3 bound volumes of Circular 2464 responses). 67 such records were originally 'not stated'; 6 received BLM-confirmed substantive patches in the same transaction; the remaining 61 (this record's batch) are inferred from directory and geographic/naming evidence. Inference is rebuttable — any record can be re-evaluated via BLM cross-reference if its Pine Ridge affiliation is questioned.
